name: deepseekharness-desktop
description: 一键安装的跨平台桌面容器(macOS / Windows),完整运行官方 DeepSeek Harness Web 壳,内置兼容性守护机制,支持第三方插件管理、更新与移除,并自动拉取官方内核最新版本。 | One-click cross-platform desktop container (macOS / Windows) running the official DeepSeek Harness Web shell, with built-in compatibility safeguards, third-party plugin management (update & remove), and automatic updates to the official runtime.
